ultrawide_fix.recommended_fix: NexusMods #17 (Beast of Reincarnation Ultrawide Fix / Lyall's ASI plugin)
ultrawide_fix.notes: Removes pillarbox black side bars and unlocks native 21:9 and 32:9 (5120x1440) Hor+ rendering. The in-game menu will continue to display 1920x1080 while the plugin overrides viewport bounds.

engine_overrides.behaviour: The game uses a compressed binary container (/Script/BeastOfReincarnation.AibouSaveDataContainer) inside borSaveDataConfig.sav to serialize all in-game Graphics, Display, and Upscaling options.
engine_overrides.action: Select options in the in-game Graphics menu and press E Confirm to serialize settings into borSaveDataConfig.sav.
